column4: componentize-py is not installed on this runner (the scheduled engine-race job sets up no Python), and this test needs a real Python guest: it compiles python-sdk/examples/held_sleep_workflow.py and holds it through a durable sleep on the real wasmtime backend, asserting the run completes in place, is charged as Python while held, and that the hold follows the requested sleep length. Whole test with no dialect arm. NOT MEASURED on this job: the count of 1 is the one skip site left in the test (the toolchain check), read from the source, not a reading of the job's own report; if the first report differs, correct this line. It runs for real in Tier 1 Gate, where python is installed and a skip is a failure, and in scripts/docker/python-toolchain.Dockerfile (measured there: passes). (cleat#4162 part A)
